messages:
Ethan (partnerships): quick flag — Acme SI reported they send mixed-granularity usage (some endpoints minute, others hourly). Our entitlement join is misaligned and we saw duplicate credits. Anyone else seen this pattern?

Maya (billing): saw a similar dump last week. Their connector falls back to hourly when queue backs up. We currently key by (customer_id, sku, hour) so minute events create overlap.

Sanjay (platform): yeah that's the root cause. Two actionable items I think: 1) define explicit contract fields so partners always include original_timestamp + window_seconds, 2) add tolerant dedupe logic for clock skew. Propose we accept event payloads with either "granularity":"minute" or provide window_seconds.

Ethan (partnerships): nailed it. Can we propose a small sample schema to share with partners?

Maya (billing): please add late-arrival semantics. we need to know how long we accept backfills to avoid bill churn. default TTL = 24h?

Sanjay (platform): cool, sample payload below (for partner docs):

```json
{
  "customer_id": "acct_12345",
  "sku": "inference-hourly",
  "usage": 12.5,
  "units": "token_seconds",
  "original_timestamp": "2026-03-20T14:37:12Z",
  "window_seconds": 60,
  "sequence_id": "seq-0001",
  "ingest_time": "2026-03-20T14:37:40Z",
  "backfill": false
}
```

Sanjay (platform): rules: if window_seconds omitted, default = 3600 (hour), accept up to 24h late with backfill=true. allow clock skew tolerance +-30s when matching windows. we should also require sequence_id for idempotency on replays.

Maya (billing): for reconciliation playbook: compare partner-reported aggregated windows vs ledger totals, run hourly diff job, surface >0.5% delta to ops. also need partner test harness with replayed minute-stream vs hourly-rollup.

Ethan (partnerships): i'll draft a partner-facing PDF + a small test harness they can run. also will add a checklist for joint go-live: schema check, sample payload validation, 72h shadow run.

DeployBot: parser-v2 schema validation rule deployed to staging at commit 9f3a2c.

Sanjay (platform): follow-ups: @Maya please own SLA for late-arrival window and threshold; @Ethan create partner doc + sample harness; i'll add dedupe/sequence_id checks in staging and create unit tests.

Maya (billing): on it. i'll circulate SLA draft by EOD and include delta alert thresholds. :thumbsup:

Ethan (partnerships): thanks — i'll loop in Acme SI once draft ready and schedule a 30m alignment. :calendar:

Sanjay (platform): perfect. will add integration test cases to marketplace-ingest repo and enable validation webhook in staging.

Maya (billing): one more note — when partners report both per-minute and hourly for same customer/sku we should prefer the finest granularity during reconciliation (i.e., minute > hour) to avoid undercount. put that in docs.

Ethan (partnerships): agreed. adding to doc. Closing this thread for now, will reopen with partner follow-up.
